newsitem.title: USA: Optimax agrees to buy Forgotten Woman.
newsitem.headline: Optimax agrees to buy Forgotten Woman.

text.p: Optimax Industries Inc said on Wednesday that it has entered a non-binding letter of intent to acquire the Forgotten Woman Inc, a chain of specialty retail stores that sells women's clothing in larger sizes, for stock.

On closing, Forgotten Woman shareholders would own more than 75 percent of the company's capital stock and the company's board of directors and management would be designated by Forgotten Woman, Optimax said.
Optimax said the agreement calls for the issuance of one share of its common stock for each share of capital stock of Forgotten Woman.
In addition, Optimax said in a statement, all outstanding warrants and options of Forgotten Woman would be assumed by the company.
